verses.en: These are the sons of Israel; Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,
verses.sm: Isaraelu; o Reupena, o Simeona, o Levi, ma luta, o Isakara, ma Sepulona, o Tanu,

verses.en: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
verses.sm: o Iosefa, ma Peniamina, o Nafatali, o Kato, ma Asera.

verses.en: The sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah: which three were born unto him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er, the firstborn of Judah, was evil in the sight of the LORD; and he slew him.
verses.sm: O atalii o Iuta; o Eru, ma Onani, ma Sila, e toatolu i latou na fanau ia te ia i le afafine o Sua o le sa Kanana. A o Eru le ulumatua a Iuta, sa leaga o ia i luma o le Aw, ona ia fasioti lea ia te ia.

verses.en: And Tamar his daughter in law bare him Pharez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.
verses.sm: O Tamara foi le aya a lona atalii na fanau ia ia te ia o Faresa ma Sera. O atalii uma o Tuta e toalima ia.

verses.en: The sons of Pharez; Hezron, and Hamul.
verses.sm: O atalii o Faresa, o Esarona ma Hamulu.

verses.en: And the sons of Zerah; Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara: five of them in all.
verses.sm: O atalii foi o Sera; o Semeri, ma Etano, ma Hemana, ma Kalakolu, ma Tarata; o i latou uma ia e toalima.

verses.en: And the sons of Carmi; Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the thing accursed.
verses.sm: O le atalii foio Karame; o Akara, o ia na faatigaina Isaraelu, o le na agasala i le mea na faatoina.

verses.en: And the sons of Ethan; Azariah.
verses.sm: O le atalii foi o Etane; o Asaria.

verses.en: The sons also of Hezron, that were born unto him; Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.
verses.sm: O atalii foi o Esarona, na fanau mai ia te ia; o Ieramaelu, ma Rama, ma Kalepo.

verses.en: And Ram begat Amminadab; and Amminadab begat Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;
verses.sm: to Na fanaua foi e Rama o Aminatapu; na fanaua foi e Aminatapu o Naasona, o le alii sili lea o le fanauga a Iuta;

verses.en: And Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz,
verses.sm: na fanaua foi e Naasona o Salemona; na fanaua foi e Salemona o Poasa;

verses.en: And Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse,
verses.sm: na fanaua foi e Poasa o Opeta; na fanaua foi e Opeta o Iese;

verses.en: And Jesse begat his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimma the third,
verses.sm: na fanaua foi e Iese lana ulumatua o Eliapo, o Apinatapa o lona toalua lea, o Sama o lona toatolu lea,

verses.en: Nethaneel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
verses.sm: 0 Natanielu o lona toafa, o Ratai o lona toalima,

verses.en: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh:
verses.sm: 0 Osema o lona toaono, o Tavita o lona toafitu;

verses.en: Whose sisters were Zeruiah, and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah; Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.
verses.sm: o latou tuafafine foi o Seruia ma Apikaila. O fanau foi a Seruia; o Apisai, ma loapo, ma Asaeli e toatolu.

verses.en: And Abigail bare Amasa: and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmeelite.
verses.sm: Na fanau mai foi e Apikaila o Amase, o le tama o Amase o letero lea o le sa Isamaeli.

verses.en: And Caleb the son of Hezron begat children of Azubah his wife, and of Jerioth: her sons are these; Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.
verses.sm: Na fanaua foi atalii o Kalepo le atalii o Esarona ia Asopa lana ava, ma leriota; o ana tama la; o lesera, ma Sopapa, ma Aretonu.

verses.en: And when Azubah was dead, Caleb took unto him Ephrath, which bare him Hur.
verses.sm: Ua oti Asopa, ona fai ava ai lea o Kalepo la Efarata, ua fanau foi la te la o Huro.

verses.en: And Hur begat Uri, and Uri begat Bezaleel.
verses.sm: Na fanaua foi e Huro o Auri, na fanaua foi e Auri, o Pesaleli.

verses.en: And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he was threescore years old; and she bare him Segub.
verses.sm: E mulimuli ane foi ona alu ane ai lea o Esarona i le afafine o Makiro o le tamá o Kiliata, na ia fai ava ai ina ua 00 i ona tausaga e Ono sefulu; na fanau foi o ia ia te ia o Sekupu.

verses.en: And Segub begat Jair, who had three and twenty cities in the land of Gilead.
verses.sm: Na fanaua foi e Sekupu o lairo; sa ia te ia o aai e lua sefulu ma le tolu i le nuu o Kiliata.

verses.en: And he took Geshur, and Aram, with the towns of Jair, from them, with Kenath, and the towns thereof, even threescore cities. All these belonged to the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
verses.sm: Na faoa e ia o Kasuri, ma Arama nai ia te i latou, atoa ma Havota-iairo, ma Kinata, atoa ma ona faoa aai, o aai ia e ono sefulu. O aai uma ia na i ai i atalii o Makiro o le tamā o Kiliata.

verses.en: And after that Hezron was dead in Caleb-ephratah, then Abiah Hezron's wife bare him Ashur the father of Tekoa.
verses.sm: Ua oti Esarona i Kalepoefarata, ona fanau lea ia te ia e Aviz le ava a Esarona o Asura O le tamā o Tikoa.

verses.en: And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were, Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, and Ahijah.
verses.sm: O atalii foi nei o Ieramaelu o le ulumatua a Esarona, o Rama o le ulumatua, ma Puna, ma Orene, ma Osema, ma Akia.

verses.en: Jerahmeel had also another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.
verses.sm: Sa ia Ieramaelu foi o le tasi avā, o lona igoa o Atara, o ia o le tina o Onama.

verses.en: And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were, Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.
verses.sm: O atalii foi nei o Rama le ulumatua a Ieramaelu; o Maasa, ma Jatinu, ma Ekeru.

verses.en: And the sons of Onam were, Shammai, and Jada. And the sons of Shammai; Nadab, and Abishur.
verses.sm: O atalii foi nei o Onama; o Samai, ma Iata. O atalii o Samai; o Natapu, ma Apisura.

verses.en: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail, and she bare him Ahban, and Molid.
verses.sm: O le igoa o le avā a Apisura o Aviaila, na fanau e ia la te ia o Akepana, ma Molita.

verses.en: And the sons of Nadab; Seled, and Appaim: but Seled died without children.
verses.sm: O atalii o Natapu; o Seleta, ma Apaima; a ua oti Seleta, e leai sana fanau.

verses.en: And the sons of Appaim; Ishi. And the sons of Ishi; Sheshan. And the children of Sheshan; Ahlai.
verses.sm: O le atalii o Apaima; o Isai. O le atalii o Isai; o Sesani. O le atalii foi o Sesani; o Akalai.

verses.en: And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai; Jether, and Jonathan: and Jether died without children.
verses.sm: O atalii foi o Iata le uso o Samai; o Ietero ma Ionatana; a ua oti Ietero, e leai sana fanau.

verses.en: And the sons of Jonathan; Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
verses.sm: O atalii foi o Ionatana; o Peleto, ma Sasa. O atalii ia 0 Ieramaelu.

verses.en: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.
verses.sm: Ua leai ni atalii o Sesani, ua na O afafine; a ua ia Sesani le auauna Aikupito, o lona igoa o lara.

verses.en: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant to wife; and she bare him Attai.
verses.sm: Ua avane e Sesani lona afafine ia lara lana auauna e fai mana aya; ua fanau foi e ia ia te ia o Atai.

verses.en: And Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,
verses.sm: Na fanaua e Atai o Natano, na fanaua e Natano o Sapata.

verses.en: And Zabad begat Ephlal, and Ephlal begat Obed,
verses.sm: Na fanaua foi e Sapata o Efalalu, na fanaua e Efalalu o Opeta,

verses.en: And Obed begat Jehu, and Jehu begat Azariah,
verses.sm: na fanaua foi e Opeta o Ieu, na fanaua foi e leu o Asaria,

verses.en: And Azariah begat Helez, and Helez begat Eleasah,
verses.sm: na fanaua foi e Asaria o Helesa, na fanaua e Helesa o Eliasa,

verses.en: And Eleasah begat Sisamai, and Sisamai begat Shallum,
verses.sm: na fanaua foi e Eliasa o Sesemai, na fanaua foi e Sesemai o Saluma,

verses.en: And Shallum begat Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begat Elishama.
verses.sm: na fanaua e Saluma o Iekamia, na fanaua foi e lekamia o Elisama.

verses.en: Now the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were, Mesha his firstborn, which was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
verses.sm: O aiaW foi o Kalepo o le uso o Ieramaelu; o Mesa O lana ulumatua, o ia O le tamā o Sifi; o atalii foi o Maresa o le tama o Heperona.

verses.en: And the sons of Hebron; Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.
verses.sm: O atalii foi o Heperona; o Koru, ma Tapua, ma Rekema, ma Sema.

verses.en: And Shema begat Raham, the father of Jorkoam: and Rekem begat Shammai.
verses.sm: Na fanaua foi e Sema o Raama, o le tamā o Iorekeata ; na fanaua foi e Rekema o Samai.

verses.en: And the son of Shammai was Maon: and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.
verses.sm: O atalii o Samai, o Meona; o Meona foi o le tama o Petesura.

verses.en: And Ephah, Caleb's concubine, bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez: and Haran begat Gazez.
verses.sm: Na fanau mai e Efa le palake a Kalepo, o Karana, ma Mosa, ma Kasese; na fanaua foi e Karana o Kasese.

verses.en: And the sons of Jahdai; Regem, and Jotham, and Gesham, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.
verses.sm: O atalii foi o lIatai; o Rekema, ma Ioѓato, ma Kaw, ta Pelete, ma Efa, ma Saapo.

verses.en: Maachah, Caleb's concubine, bare Sheber, and Tirhanah.
verses.sm: Na fanau mai e Maaka le palake a Kalepo, o Severa, ma Tirekena.

verses.en: She bare also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibea: and the daughter of Caleb was Achsa.
verses.sm: Na fanau foi e ia 0 Saapo o le tama o Matamana, o Seva o le tama o Makapena, ma le tama o Kipea. O le afafine o Kalepo o Akesa ia.

verses.en: These were the sons of Caleb the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah; Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim,
verses.sm: so O atalii foi nei o Kalepo le atalii o Huro, o le ulumatua a Efarata; o Sovala o le tamà o Kiriata-iarima,

verses.en: Salma the father of Beth-lehem, Hareph the father of Beth-gader.
verses.sm: o Salema o le tama o Peteleema, o Harefa o le tama o Petekateru.

verses.en: And Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim had sons; Haroeh, and half of the Manahethites.
verses.sm: O Sovala o le tama o Kiriata-iarima, sa ia te ia o atalii; o Haroe, ma le tasi vaega o Manaka.

verses.en: And the families of Kirjath-jearim; the Ithrites, and the Puhites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zareathites, and the Eshtaulites.
verses.sm: O aiga o Kiriata-iarima; o sa Ieterò, ma sa Puti, ma sa Sumati, ma sa Meserai; o i latou ia na tutupu ai sa Soraá, ma sa Esetaola.

verses.en: The sons of Salma; Beth-lehem, and the Netophathites, Ataroth, the house of Joab, and half of the Manahethites, the Zorites.
verses.sm: O atalii o Salema; o Peteleema, ma sa Netopa, o Atarota, o Peteioapu, ma le tasi vaega o sa Manaka, o sa Soraa.

verses.en: And the families of the scribes which dwelt at Jabez; the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and Suchathites. These are the Kenites that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab.
verses.sm: O aiga foi o e tusiupu sa nonofo i lapesa; o sa Tirati, o sa Semaia, o sa Suka. O sa Keni ia e na tutupu ia Hamato, o le tupuga o le aiga o Rakapa. O le gafa o Tavita O atalii nei o
